short: The crate body — feature-free substrate, with the minter and the ACP behind features
is: The crate body — a feature-free substrate (`plc`, `did`, `handle`, `keys`, `vault`, `policy`, `store`, `directory`, `error`) with the minter and the ACP behind features.
conventions: Private modules are re-exported from `lib.rs`; only `plc` and `acp` are `pub mod`.
Unit tests live beside the code and use `memory.rs` fakes; nothing needs a service or a container.
No transport, framework or RNG of its own: each resource arrives as a trait or parameter (F49).

fs.name: acp.rs
fs.role: `acp` feature root — ACP core module docs + re-exports

fs.name: acp/
fs.role: the ACP core — records, sign/verify, ports, status lists, policy

fs.name: directory.rs
fs.role: the `PlcDirectory` seam + `NoopPlcDirectory`; the consumer implements the client

fs.name: lib.rs
fs.role: crate root — module map, feature gates, public re-exports

fs.name: minter.rs
fs.role: `minter` feature — Minter: mint / update handle / tombstone

fs.name: plc.rs
fs.role: did:plc operations — build, sign, hash (byte-exact core, always on)

fs.name: policy.rs
fs.role: MintPolicy — identity shape as data (F8 strict updates)

fs.name: store.rs
fs.role: the storage seam — `KeyStore`, `PlcOperationLog` + the op-log record

fs.name: vault.rs
fs.role: SecretVault — envelope encryption under a root key (F4)
